Title: [Notifications] - Verify dynamic record references are displayed in notification messages.
Description: Validate that notification messages correctly display the entity name, record List As value, and user information when records are updated or deleted by another user.
Precondition:
Notifications are enabled in the system.
Two active users exist in the platform.
At least one entity with configured List As values exists.
Steps:
Log in using User A credentials.
Navigate to an entity and create a new record.
Log out from User A and log in using User B credentials.
Locate the record created by User A.
Modify or delete the record created by User A.
Log out from User B and log back in using User A credentials.
Open the Notifications panel.
Locate the generated notification related to the updated or deleted record.
Verify the notification message content.
ExpectedResult:
The user logs into the application successfully.
The record is created successfully.
User B logs into the application successfully.
The record is displayed successfully.
The action is completed successfully and generates a notification event.
User A logs into the application successfully.
The notification list is displayed successfully.
The notification is displayed successfully.
The notification correctly displays the entity name, the record List As value, and the user who performed the action.

Title: [Notifications] - Verify "Delete All" button functionality and bulk deletion in the Notifications Drawer.
Description: Validate that the "Delete All" button is correctly displayed in the Notifications Drawer, triggers a confirmation modal, and permanently deletes all notifications upon confirmation, updating the drawer state and navbar badge counter accordingly.
Precondition:
The user has access to the Notifications Drawer.
The user has at least one notification in their notification log.
Steps:
Log in to the platform using valid credentials.
Open the Notifications Drawer.
Locate the action bar containing the "Dismiss All" button.
Verify the visual styling of the "Delete All" button.
Click the "Delete All" button.
Select a "Cancel" option, if available.
Click the "Delete All" button again and confirm the action.
Observe the Notifications Drawer after the API returns a successful response.
Observe the navbar notification badge counter.
Reload the page and reopen the Notifications Drawer.
ExpectedResult:
The user logs into the application successfully.
The drawer opens successfully and displays the existing notifications.
A "Delete All" button (or trash icon with label) is displayed adjacent to the "Dismiss All" button.
The button is beside the "Dismiss All" button with the same proportions
A confirmation modal/popover is displayed with the message: "Are you sure you want to permanently delete all notifications? This action cannot be undone."
The modal closes and no notifications are deleted.
The bulk-deletion API request is triggered successfully.
The drawer instantly clears and transitions to an empty state illustration.
The badge counter resets to zero or is no longer displayed.
No previous notifications are displayed, confirming the permanent deletion.

Title: [Notifications] Verify Notification Messages Display Readable Content Without Raw HTML
Description: To verify Notification Messages Display Readable Content Without Raw HTML Description: This test aims to ensure that notification messages are properly formatted and displayed in a user-friendly manner without any raw HTML tags visible, allowing for clear and easily understandable communication with users.
Steps:
Go to the website https://app.datascend.net in your browser and log in with the correct credentials
Navigate to any module or entity capable of generating notifications (e.g., an entity containing a Rich Text field or a Workflow that sends notifications).
As User A, create or identify a record that can generate a notification, or identify a workflow that sends notifications
As User B, modify a Rich Text field of User A's record or execute/update a workflow that sends a notification to User A
Log in as User A and open the Notifications panel.
Review the notification message.
If the notification message is long, verify its visual behavior.
Repeat the validation with another notification source (Rich Text or Workflow, whichever was not tested previously).
ExpectedResult:
Make sure that the screen load and display the dashboard
The module is accessible and ready for testing.
The record or workflow is available for the test.
The action completes successfully and a notification is generated.
The newly generated notification is displayed.
The notification displays readable content and does not show raw HTML tags or encoded HTML entities (e.g., <p>, <Strong>, <,  ).
The message is truncated with an ellipsis (...) and the complete content is available on hover (tooltip), if applicable.
Notifications from different sources are displayed consistently without exposing raw HTML or formatting issues.
